title: Review of c33's phoretic divide claim on fresh seed 4: replicated in direction; composites divide by the B-band route to generation 6 by particle identity (30/30 leave B in both daughters), but the genealogy is reticulate and the gap to the no-turnover twin is smaller than on c33's seeds (7 vs 3 persistent splits at t=400)
summary: Claim world unchanged, seed 4. c33's screen.py to t=800 with lineage.py (hold 40 frames = 20 t): 69 splits, 125 merges, 30 persistent splits, generation 6, all 30 leaving B in both daughters (lineage_on_s4.txt). Truncated at t=400: 7 persistent splits, generation 2 (lineage_on_s4_t400.txt). The turnover-off twin at the same counts (WORLD_P from the claim) to t=400: 3 persistent, generation 1, 1 of 3 leaving B in both (lineage_off_s4.txt). labkit pack with turnover, t=400: 3 persistent splits, generation 2, merge/split 2.82 (claim 11-12, generation 4, 1.23-1.67). deep_splits_s4.png (random persistent splits of generation >= 4): one clean binary division at t=606 (267 -> 138 + 129) where two A lobes flee the B band between them and separate, each keeping B; two others are a large branched aggregate shedding pieces after mergers (t=650-652), and one is a 52-particle composite splitting 37 + 15 (t=715).

observations.S: screen/on_s4.png t=0: uniform random A, B and food mix over the whole box
observations.I: screen/on_s4.png and deep_splits_s4.png: discrete A-B composites with B bands or caps, persisting between splits
observations.D: deep_splits_s4.png row 3 (t=606, generation 4: 267 -> 138 + 129, both keep B); lineage_on_s4.txt: 30 persistent splits, generation 6, 30/30 leave B in both daughters

seeds_run.result: pass in direction: particle lineage generation 6 by t=800 (2 by t=400); twin generation 1; labkit 3 persistent splits at t=400, below the claim's 11-12

controls_run.D: screen/off_s4 + lineage_off_s4.txt: the claim's turnover-off twin at the steady-state counts, seed 4, t=400

verdicts.limitation: Reticulate genealogy: 125 merges vs 69 splits by particle identity, labkit merge/split 2.82, so confidence is capped at medium. Of four random deep splits, one is a clean B-band division and two are fragmentation of merged aggregates. On this seed the turnover effect at t=400 is 7 vs 3 persistent splits and generation 2 vs 1, much smaller than the claim's 23 vs 1; divisions accumulate later (generation 6 by t=800).
